name: x-powertoys
description: The morphe X patches as a Firefox extension for x.com

scripts.lint: npx --yes web-ext@8 lint --source-dir . --ignore-files test package.json README.md
scripts.start: npx --yes web-ext@8 run --source-dir . --ignore-files test package.json README.md
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext@8 build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test package.json README.md
scripts.sign: npx --yes web-ext@8 sign --source-dir . --channel=unlisted --ignore-files test package.json README.md
